name: master-ball
short_effect: Catches a wild Pokémon every time.
flavor_text:
The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of
performance. With it, you will catch any wild
Pokémon without fail.

name: ultra-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 2×.
flavor_text:
An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides
a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than
a Great Ball.

name: great-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 1.5×.
flavor_text:
A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides
a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than
a standard Poké Ball.

name: poke-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
flavor_text:
A device for catching wild Pokémon. It’s thrown like
a ball at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating
its target.

name: safari-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone.  Success rate is 1.5×.
flavor_text:
A special Poké Ball that was used in the Safari Zone
in the Kanto region and in the Great Marsh in the
Sinnoh region.

name: net-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for water and bug Pokémon.
flavor_text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more
effective when attempting to catch Water- or
Bug-type Pokémon.

name: dive-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.5× when underwater, fishing, or surfing.
flavor_text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that works
especially well when catching Pokémon that
live underwater.

name: nest-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.9× for level 1 Pokémon, and drops steadily to 1× at level 30.
flavor_text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more
effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.

name: repeat-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for previously-caught Pokémon.

A somewhat different Poké Ball that works
especially well on a Pokémon species that has been
caught before.

name: timer-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate increases by 0.1× (Gen V: 0.3×) every turn, to a max of 4×.

A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes
progressively more effective at catching Pokémon
the more turns that are taken in battle.

name: luxury-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Caught Pokémon start with 200 happiness.

A particularly comfortable Poké Ball that makes a
wild Pokémon quickly grow friendlier after
being caught.

name: premier-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
flavor_text:
A somewhat rare Poké Ball that was made as a
commemorative item used to celebrate an event of
some sort.

name: dusk-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.5× at night and in caves.
flavor_text:
A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it
easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark

wild encounter.

name: cherish-ball
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
flavor_text:
A quite rare Poké Ball that has been crafted in
order to commemorate a special occasion of
some sort.

name: marble

A round glass marble. You can see colored glass
inside the transparent marble.

name: lone-earring
flavor_text: A single earring that somebody dropped.

name: beach-glass
flavor_text:
A piece of colored glass. Waves have rounded its edges.

name: gold-leaf

name: silver-leaf
flavor_text:

name: polished-mud-ball
flavor_text:

name: tropical-shell

name: heavy-duty-boots

name: blunder-policy

name: utility-umbrella

name: wishing-piece
flavor_text:
Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract
a wild Dynamax Pokémon.

name: cracked-pot
flavor_text:
A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of
Pokémon evolve. It may be cracked, but tea poured
from it is delicious.

name: chipped-pot
flavor_text:
A peculiar teapot that can make a certain species of
Pokémon evolve. It may be chipped, but tea poured
from it is delicious.

name: max-honey
flavor_text:
Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this
honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also
has the same effect as a Max Revive.

name: max-mushrooms
flavor_text:
Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax
forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

name: galarica-twig
flavor_text:
A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows
in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material
for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

name: galarica-cuff
flavor_text:
A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the
Pokémon very happy.

name: armorite-ore
flavor_text:
Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor.
Something good will happen if you give it to a collector
on the Isle of Armor.

name: galarica-wreath
flavor_text:
A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs.
Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes
the Pokémon very happy.

name: dynite-ore
flavor_text:
Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair.
Something good will happen if you give it to a
collector in the Crown Tundra.

name: ability-patch
flavor_text:
A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability
to have a rare Ability.

name: linking-cord

name: lafeather-ball

Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

name: lawing-ball
